response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400 GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance FROM per_account;

assumptions.assumption: The average balance per account uses every transaction with amount >= 2400, including VYBER and other types, because only the signed-amount figure is restricted to PRIJEM and VYDAJ.

The final averages are unweighted means of the per-account figures, with one value per account. Accounts whose signed average is NULL are skipped for the first figure only (AVG ignores NULLs) but still count for the balance figure.

alternatives.interpretation: The average balance is also restricted to transactions that count toward the signed amount (PRIJEM or VYDAJ only). Accounts with no such transactions are skipped for both figures.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400 AND type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance FROM per_account;
